title: Initial clinical evaluation of a device for continuous monitoring of physiological parameters and artificial intelligence-based analysis for the early detection of health abnormalities in patients with chronic conditions and multiple pathologies, in outpatient and home settings
official: Initial clinical evaluation of a device for continuous monitoring of physiological parameters and artificial intelligence-based analysis for the early detection of health abnormalities in patients with chronic conditions and multiple pathologies, in outpatient and home settings
summary: Not provided at time of registration
conditions: Continuous monitoring of physiological parameters and artificial intelligence-based analysis for the early detection of health anomalies in patients with chronic and multiple conditions, in outpatient and home settings
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1.	Age ≥40 years
2.	At least two comorbidities or a stabilised chronic condition (e.g. hypertension, diabetes, atrial fibrillation, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), or heart failure)
3.	Regular follow-up at one of the two study centres
4.	Ability to use the device and the application, either independently or with the assistance of a caregiver or family member
5.	Presence of an identified primary care physician
6.	Written informed consent obtained prior to any research-related procedure
7.	Coverage by a social security scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1.	Severe acute condition requiring immediate care
2.	Affiliation with a social security scheme
3.	Severe cognitive impairment compromising use of the device or understanding of information
4.	Unstable psychiatric disorders
5.	Palliative care situation
6.	Use of a medical device considered incompatible
7.	Person subject to a legal protection measure, minor, person deprived of liberty, or person unable to express consent
8.	Refusal to participate
